title: The Hunters' Shrine
text: Hunters come to this shrine of skulls to ask the hunt's spirit for luck. Deer, boar, bear and wolf skulls are piled into a little hill, their antlers woven together into a roof. There is fresh blood on the altar stone; someone has prayed here very recently.

options.label: The most blooded prays at the shrine of skulls, one hunter to another.

outcomes.text: The hunt's spirit answers with a breath of musk and blood. Luck comes with it.

options.label: Leave an offering on the bloody stone, and ask the spirit for swift feet.

outcomes.text: A little luck follows, and for a while your feet are as quick as a deer's.

options.label: Take a skull from the pile. The spirit has so many.

outcomes.text: The spirit is displeased. The antler roof creaks, and something follows you out. The skull is old and hard as wyrmbone.
